Subject: Contract kickoff — MSA + SOW (Greenwave)

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Legal has asked us to kick off the contracting process so we can target a June 15 start for integration. Attaching a quick Party Sheet and our initial SOW (draft).

High level asks from our side:
- Confirm Redwood's standard MSA + order form process and expected turnaround on redlines.
- SOC2 evidence and data residency notes for our procurement team.
- Clarify billing cadence, seat counting definition, and overage handling.

Can you confirm who at Redwood will be our contracting point and what the typical SLAs are for first-pass redlines? We'd like to schedule a 30-min kickoff this week if possible.

Proposed plan:
1) Internal intake & priority triage (today) — Kim will take security/residency questions; Marissa will manage legal redlines.
2) First-pass redlines back to you within 3 business days (target Tue 25 May).
3) 30-min kickoff with procurement and legal to confirm billing/seat definition and SOW scope — are you available Mon 24 May 10–11am PT?

Please confirm the preferred signer and if there are any carveouts we should know about up front. Also: could you drop the SOC2 attestation in the thread or a link to the auditor report?

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: david.kim@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Greenwave intake — security / billing flags

David/Marissa — quick intake notes after a skim of Greenwave's Party Sheet and SOW:
- Data residency: Greenwave indicates EU clients but primary instance will be US. Need to confirm whether they require EU-only residency for specific customers; mark as medium risk.
- SOC2: they attached a high-level attestation PDF but no auditor name. Ask for auditor report or more granular controls evidence (access logs, retention SLA).
- Billing: SOW references monthly invoice but also an annual commit discount structure. Clarify seat counting: they use "active seats" and reserve the right to reassign seats monthly — that should map to our seat-counting definitions.

Priority: security evidence before legal redlines (we might need to add an exhibit listing retention and access controls).

I can own the evidence ask; Marissa, recommend we hold off on substantive redline delivery until we get SOC2 auditor report. If procurement wants quick turnaround we can send templated redlines limited to non-security commercial items.

Kimberly Park
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks J./Nina — confirmed for Mon 24 May 10:00–10:30am PT. Calendar invite sent (includes Zoom link). Attendees from Redwood: me (contracts), Kim (security), Marissa (legal), Karthik (account lead).

Immediate asks before the kickoff:

- Nina/J., please confirm whether any customers in scope require EU-only residency. If so, include which customer names or "all EU customers."
